examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Scroller
examples.description: This example demonstrates the use of some attributes of the Scroll component and the Scroller.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing Nested Scrolling (Method 1)
examples.description: This example uses the onScrollFrameBegin event to achieve nested scrolling between an inner List component and an outer Scroll component.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing Nested Scrolling (Method 2)
examples.description: This example uses the nestedScroll attribute to achieve nested scrolling between an inner List component and an outer Scroll component.

examples.title: Example 4: Implementing Nested Scrolling with Parent-to-Child Scrolling Propagation
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to propagate scrolling from a parent component to a child component using the enableScrollInteraction attribute and the onScrollFrameBegin event.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting Scroll Snapping
examples.description: This example shows how to set scroll snapping for a Scroll component.

examples.title: Example 6: Obtaining the Index of a Child Component
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to obtain the index of a child component in a List component.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting Edge Fading
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a Scroll component with an edge fading effect and set the length of the fading edge.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting the Single-Side Edge Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set a single-side edge effect for the Scroll component using the edgeEffect API.

examples.title: Example 9: Implementing the Swipe-to-Turn-Pages Feature
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement the swipe-to-turn-pages feature for a Scroll component using the enablePaging API.

examples.title: Example 10: Implementing the Overscroll Stay Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement the overscroll stay effect for a Scroll component using the scrollTo API.

examples.title: Example 11: Implementing Free Scrolling and Scaling
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement free scrolling and scaling of the Scroll component. This functionality is supported since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 12: Obtaining the Total Content Size
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to obtain the total content size. This functionality is supported since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 13: Setting Scrolling Events
examples.description:
This example obtains a UIScrollEvent instance via getEvent('Scroll') on a FrameNode and sets scroll event callbacks for a Scroll component. This approach is intended for scenarios where the page code cannot be directly modified to use declarative callbacks.
The UIScrollEvent API is supported since API version 19.
